description: Widen a section so its tools become visible in tools/list. For a tiered section, tier "simple" or "full" (default full) picks how much to show; on/off sections take no tier. Enabling never narrows a section: asking for simple on a section already at full leaves it at full. The SDK emits tools/list_changed automatically; the client refreshes its tool list mid-conversation. Be sparing: every enabled tool adds its schema to your context budget. Run list_tool_groups first to see what is available.

group.description: Name of the section to enable. Run list_tool_groups to see available sections.

tier.description: Tier for a tiered section (default full). Not accepted for on/off sections.

name: enable_tool_group
title: Enable tool group
